title: Rishtey - A Grand Celebration
desc: After falling in love with each other, a man and a woman must overcome obstacles and the generation-long rift between their families.

title: Jaan
desc: A top cop hires a man to guard his grandchild, unaware of the lurking threat. However, this protector is a hitman sent by kin to bump off the successor and grab the hefty estate.

title: Hindustan Ki Kasam
desc: Two twin brothers, separated at birth, grow up as a Hindu in India and a Muslim in Pakistan. However, fate reunites them on opposite sides of the battlefield.

title: Valimai
desc: When a city's crime rate rises, it is up to Arjun, a police officer, to restore order.
